name: ciphermaniac
description: Pokemon TCG tournament data visualization tool

scripts.dev:functions: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.lint: eslint *.config.mjs *.config.ts .dependency-cruiser.cjs src shared functions scripts tests .github/scripts --ext .ts,.tsx,.mts,.mjs,.js --max-warnings 0 --report-unused-disable-directives
scripts.lint:fix: eslint *.config.mjs *.config.ts .dependency-cruiser.cjs src shared functions scripts tests .github/scripts --ext .ts,.tsx,.mts,.mjs,.js --fix --max-warnings 0 --report-unused-disable-directives
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:domain && npm run lint && npm run check:design
scripts.validate:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:python && npm run test:e2e:local
scripts.test:python: node scripts/quality/run-tool.mjs python -m unittest discover -s .github/scripts/tests -p test_*.py
scripts.verify: npm run verify:static && npm run verify:tests && npm run verify:build && npm run test:e2e:local
scripts.lint:workflows: node scripts/quality/run-tool.mjs actionlint && node scripts/quality/run-tool.mjs shellcheck .husky/pre-commit .husky/commit-msg
scripts.verify:static: npm run format:check && npm run validate && npm run knip && npm run knip:production && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint:python && npm run lint:workflows && npm run check:metadata && npm run check:generated
scripts.verify:tests: npm run test:coverage && npm run coverage:check && npm run coverage:check:domain && npm run coverage:check:core && npm run coverage:check:changed && npm run test:python
scripts.verify:build: npm run build && npm run check:bundle

author: Ciphermaniac
